Subject: Quick ask — extended sandbox + additional credits for regulatory PoC

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our compliance team reviewed Redwood’s private deployment options and we have a hard date for a regulator-facing proof-of-concept: the submission window opens mid-July. To complete the audit run and ingest our redacted patient telemetry, we need additional tokens and a 60–90 day sandbox extension beyond your standard PLG window.

- We estimate ~25M tokens over 60 days for model tuning and evals.
- Need SOC2/ISO evidence and confirmation of data retention controls before we send any data.
- Procurement needs a short SOW and a one-page commercial exception to sign off.

We’re excited to move fast but the procurement cycle is tight. Is there an option for a one-time sandbox uplift (free credits + extended sandbox) in exchange for a signed SOW and a commitment to a pilot contract if the evaluation passes?

I’ve attached a short compliance brief and a draft SOW.

Appreciate any flexibility — regulator timeline is immovable.

Best,

I can support a one-time exception, subject to the following non-negotiables:

   - Allows Redwood to terminate access and revoke credits if controls are violated.

Sales Ops: spool up a time-limited promo code and tie it to HEO-482. Finance will treat any unused credit as waived only after the contract conversion; we need a reconciliation plan.

I’ll draft a 1‑page addendum tonight.
